answers.question: Why had the certificate not been renewed automatically?
answers.answer: Current state: The API integration certificate expired at midnight, causing a 3-hour 40-minute outage for 61 customers. The renewal automation `cert-renew` had been switched off in July and was never restored until now. Engineering has re-enabled the automation on ops-01 with alerting configured for 30 and 7 days before expiry under ticket XYZ-2143.
